children: The recent recovery in ResMed's share price prompts Morgans analyst Derek Jellinek to moderate his bullishness. Lowering his recommendation to "accumulate" from "buy," Jellinek writes in a note that healthy U.S. device demand, mask innovation, productivity initiatives and strong capital returns represent sound underlying fundamentals for the breathing-tech supplier. However, he points out that its stronger-than-expected September quarter contained multiple one-off gains. Morgans raises its target price on ResMed's ASX-listed stock 1.3%, to 40.00 Australian dollars. Shares are down 2.5%, at A$32.62. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
